title: Set the scene and tell a past story
lessons:
## Goal and starting point
Tell a past story that separates the situation from what changed. Understand a short account, reconstruct its order, and write a clear anecdote. Prerequisites: present nous forms, Chapter 10 auxiliary/participle patterns, agreement and questions. Check yourself: report three completed actions with avoir, then one arrival with être. If you cannot, retrieve those chunks first; a new past tense does not replace passé composé.

## 1. Form the imparfait
Take the present nous form, remove -ons, then add -ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient for je, tu, il/elle/on, nous, vous, ils/elles. From `nous parlons` — we speak, obtain `je parlais, tu parlais, il parlait, nous parlions, vous parliez, ils parlaient` — I/you/he/we/you/they was/were speaking or used to speak. From `nous finissons` — we finish, obtain `elle finissait` — she was finishing/used to finish. The stem is not always the infinitive: `nous faisons → je faisais` — we do → I was doing; `nous prenons → je prenais` — we take → I was taking; `nous buvons → je buvais` — we drink → I was drinking. Être is the main stem exception: `j'étais, tu étais, il était, nous étions, vous étiez, elles étaient` — I was, you were, he was, we were, you were, they were.

Keep spelling that preserves sound: manger gives `je mangeais` — I was eating, but `nous mangions` — we were eating; commencer gives `je commençais` — I was starting, but `nous commencions` — we were starting. Verbs whose stem ends in i keep both i letters before -ions/-iez: `nous étudiions` — we were studying; `vous riiez` — you were laughing. Pleuvoir is mostly impersonal: `il pleuvait` — it was raining. No auxiliary is needed in the imparfait. Do not add avoir before parlais.

## 2. Choose a viewpoint, not an English keyword
The imparfait shows a past situation from inside: background, an action in progress, a habit, a state. `La gare était pleine et il faisait froid.` — The station was full and it was cold. `Je lisais quand le téléphone a sonné.` — I was reading when the phone rang. Reading is the ongoing frame; the ring is the event. `Chaque dimanche, nous préparions un repas ensemble.` — Every Sunday, we used to prepare a meal together. This describes a past routine without presenting its boundaries.

Passé composé presents a completed event or bounded whole: `Nous avons préparé le repas en une heure.` — We prepared the meal in an hour. It can describe something long or repeated if it is viewed as a finished total: `J'ai travaillé dans ce magasin pendant cinq ans.` — I worked in this shop for five years. `J'ai appelé trois fois.` — I called three times. Long does not automatically mean imparfait, and short does not automatically mean passé composé. Hier, souvent and pendant are clues to meaning, not tense switches. Compare `Avant, je marchais souvent.` — Before, I often walked, with `Pendant les vacances, j'ai marché tous les jours.` — During the holiday, I walked every day, a completed holiday total.

Two simultaneous ongoing actions often both use imparfait: `Pendant que je cuisinais, Léa mettait la table.` — While I was cooking, Léa was setting the table. A sequence of completed changes often uses passé composé: `Elle est entrée, a posé son sac et a souri.` — She came in, put down her bag and smiled. Avoid alternating tenses mechanically by sentence.

## 3. States can become events
Many feelings and thoughts use imparfait as background: `Je savais où aller.` — I knew where to go. `Je voulais parler au responsable.` — I wanted to speak to the manager. But a completed discovery or attempt can use passé composé: `J'ai su la nouvelle par ma sœur.` — I learned the news from my sister. `J'ai pu ouvrir la porte.` — I managed to open the door. Compare `Je pouvais ouvrir la porte.` — I was able/allowed to open the door; this does not say whether I did. `J'avais peur.` — I was afraid, frames a state; `J'ai eu peur quand la lumière s'est éteinte.` — I got scared when the light went out, presents a reaction. Context matters; do not ban passé composé with être, avoir or mental verbs.

## 4. Time anchors and listener support
Start with when and where, give only relevant background, introduce a change, then explain the outcome. `Ce matin-là, je cherchais l'entrée. Soudain, un agent m'a appelé. Finalement, j'ai trouvé mon groupe.` — That morning, I was looking for the entrance. Suddenly, an officer called me. Finally, I found my group. Useful chunks: `à cette époque` — at that time; `tout à coup` — suddenly; `pendant que` — while; `au début` — at first; `finalement` — in the end. A story is easier to follow with named people before pronouns. Do not translate English eventually as éventuellement: finalement often fits, whereas éventuellement means possibly/if needed.

## 5. Listening and pronunciation
The endings -ais, -ait and -aient usually sound the same: parlais, parlait, parlaient. The pronoun identifies the subject. Contrast `je parlais` — I was speaking and `j'ai parlé` — I spoke; many voices distinguish their final vowels, but this varies by accent. Use context as well as sound. In `nous étudiions`, keep the stem and ending; do not delete a written i just because it is hard to hear. Synthetic audio is a decoding aid with limited natural rhythm and accent variety, not an authentic exam recording. Try once at normal speed, note gist, then use replay in learning mode only if needed.

## 6. Think before revealing
A. Put attendre into imparfait for nous. B. Tell the listener you were waiting when the bus arrived. C. Say you called four times yesterday as a finished total. D. Explain why I was tired can be background, but I was ill for two days can be a bounded episode.

:::answer
A. `Nous attendions.` — We were waiting/used to wait. B. `J'attendais quand le bus est arrivé.` — I was waiting when the bus arrived. C. `Hier, j'ai appelé quatre fois.` — Yesterday I called four times. D. `J'étais fatigué, alors je suis rentré.` — I was tired, so I went home, gives a background state. `J'ai été malade pendant deux jours, puis j'ai repris le travail.` — I was ill for two days, then returned to work, presents the illness as a completed episode. A female speaker writes fatiguée and rentrée in the first example. The speaker's viewpoint matters more than the English word was.
:::

## 7. Integrated practice and review
For listening, draw two columns: scene and change. For reading, underline the event that moves the story forward. Speak once with keywords and again with a new ending; write a different story rather than transcribing the oral model. Reuse Chapter 9 descriptions and Chapter 10 irregular participles. Bank 001–025 practises scenes, 026–050 interruptions and events, 051–075 habits and viewpoints, and 076–100 transfer. Split it into four sessions. In a four-hour session, reserve 35 minutes retrieval, 45 listening, 40 reading, 45 speaking, 45 writing and 30 error correction. Revisit a day, three days, a week and two weeks later. Log the intended meaning before the corrected tense. If you overuse imparfait, retell only the completed changes; if you overuse passé composé, describe the scene for 30 seconds with no new events. Repeated success on a memorized story is not fresh evidence of general readiness.

bank.fr: La salle était presque vide.
bank.en: The room was almost empty.

bank.fr: Il faisait lourd avant l'orage.
bank.en: It was muggy before the storm.

bank.fr: Nous attendions près du guichet.
bank.en: We were waiting near the counter.

bank.fr: Les enfants jouaient dans la cour.
bank.en: The children were playing in the courtyard.

bank.fr: J'avais du mal à lire le panneau.
bank.en: I was having trouble reading the sign.

bank.fr: Le bus roulait très lentement.
bank.en: The bus was moving very slowly.

bank.fr: Une odeur de pain remplissait la rue.
bank.en: A smell of bread filled the street.

bank.fr: Vous travailliez encore à cette heure-là ?
bank.en: Were you still working at that hour?

bank.fr: Les fenêtres donnaient sur le canal.
bank.en: The windows overlooked the canal.

bank.fr: Je ne connaissais personne dans l'équipe.
bank.en: I did not know anyone on the team.

bank.fr: Ma sœur portait un manteau rouge.
bank.en: My sister was wearing a red coat.

bank.fr: Il pleuvait depuis le matin.
bank.en: It had been raining since the morning.

bank.fr: La connexion semblait instable.
bank.en: The connection seemed unstable.

bank.fr: Nous cherchions une place assise.
bank.en: We were looking for a seat.

bank.fr: Les clients devenaient impatients.
bank.en: The customers were becoming impatient.

bank.fr: J'étudiais près de la bibliothèque.
bank.en: I was studying near the library.

bank.fr: Nous étudiions ensemble après le dîner.
bank.en: We used to study together after dinner.
bank.source: Vous étudiiez ensemble après le dîner.
bank.prompt: Change the subject from vous to nous, keeping the imparfait.

bank.fr: Vous riiez pendant la projection.
bank.en: You were laughing during the screening.

bank.fr: Je mangeais quand tu as appelé.
bank.en: I was eating when you called.

bank.fr: Nous commencions à perdre patience.
bank.en: We were beginning to lose patience.

bank.fr: Elle faisait la queue dehors.
bank.en: She was queuing outside.

bank.fr: Je prenais toujours le même chemin.
bank.en: I always used to take the same route.

bank.fr: Le café servait des repas simples.
bank.en: The café used to serve simple meals.

bank.fr: Nous buvions du thé après l'atelier.
bank.en: We used to drink tea after the workshop.

bank.fr: J'étais responsable des inscriptions.
bank.en: I was responsible for registrations.

bank.fr: Je lisais quand l'écran s'est éteint.
bank.en: I was reading when the screen went dark.

bank.fr: Le téléphone a sonné pendant la pause.
bank.en: The phone rang during the break.

bank.fr: Elle dormait quand le voisin a frappé.
bank.en: She was sleeping when the neighbour knocked.

bank.fr: Nous traversions lorsque le feu a changé.
bank.en: We were crossing when the light changed.

bank.fr: Il réparait son vélo quand je suis arrivée.
bank.en: He was repairing his bike when I arrived.

bank.fr: La porte s'est refermée derrière nous.
bank.en: The door closed again behind us.

bank.fr: Je cuisinais pendant qu'il rangeait.
bank.en: I was cooking while he was tidying.

bank.fr: Pendant qu'on discutait, le train est parti.
bank.en: While we were talking, the train left.

bank.fr: J'ai glissé parce que le sol était mouillé.
bank.en: I slipped because the floor was wet.

bank.fr: Elle avait faim, alors elle a commandé.
bank.en: She was hungry, so she ordered.

bank.fr: Il faisait froid, mais nous sommes sortis.
bank.en: It was cold, but we went out.

bank.fr: Je cherchais l'adresse et j'ai reconnu Léa.
bank.en: I was looking for the address and recognized Léa.
bank.prompt: Add a discovery to a scene.

bank.fr: Le bébé pleurait quand sa mère est revenue.
bank.en: The baby was crying when his mother returned.

bank.fr: On nettoyait la salle quand l'alarme a retenti.
bank.en: We were cleaning the room when the alarm sounded.

bank.fr: Je pensais à autre chose et j'ai raté l'arrêt.
bank.en: I was thinking about something else and missed the stop.

bank.fr: La foule attendait, puis les portes ont ouvert.
bank.en: The crowd was waiting, then the doors opened.

bank.fr: J'ai appelé trois fois sans réponse.
bank.en: I called three times without an answer.

bank.fr: Nous avons marché pendant quatre heures.
bank.en: We walked for four hours.

bank.fr: Il est entré, a salué et s'est assis.
bank.en: He entered, greeted everyone and sat down.

bank.fr: J'ai été malade tout le week-end.
bank.en: I was ill all weekend.

bank.fr: Le trajet a duré deux heures.
bank.en: The journey lasted two hours.

bank.fr: Soudain, une branche est tombée.
bank.en: Suddenly, a branch fell.

bank.fr: Elle a répété la consigne deux fois.
bank.en: She repeated the instruction twice.

bank.fr: Nous avons travaillé ici pendant dix ans.
bank.en: We worked here for ten years.

bank.fr: Finalement, j'ai trouvé une autre entrée.
bank.en: In the end, I found another entrance.

bank.fr: Avant, je louais une chambre chez l'habitant.
bank.en: Before, I used to rent a room in someone's home.

bank.fr: Le samedi, mon père réparait les vélos.
bank.en: On Saturdays, my father used to repair bikes.

bank.fr: À cette époque, on payait en espèces.
bank.en: At that time, we used to pay cash.

bank.fr: Quand j'étais enfant, je collectionnais les cartes.
bank.en: When I was a child, I collected cards.

bank.fr: Nous allions souvent au bord du fleuve.
bank.en: We often used to go to the riverside.

bank.fr: Ma grand-mère connaissait tous les commerçants.
bank.en: My grandmother knew all the shopkeepers.

bank.fr: Je voulais changer d'horaire.
bank.en: I wanted to change my schedule.

bank.fr: J'ai voulu intervenir, mais on m'a interrompu.
bank.en: I tried to speak up, but I was interrupted.

bank.fr: Elle pouvait travailler chez elle.
bank.en: She was able to work from home.

bank.fr: Elle a pu récupérer son dossier.
bank.en: She managed to retrieve her file.

bank.fr: Je savais utiliser cette machine.
bank.en: I knew how to use that machine.

bank.fr: J'ai su la nouvelle par un collègue.
bank.en: I learned the news from a colleague.

bank.fr: Nous avions peur de manquer le départ.
bank.en: We were afraid of missing the departure.

bank.fr: J'ai eu peur quand le câble a cassé.
bank.en: I got scared when the cable snapped.

bank.fr: Il aimait expliquer les choses simplement.
bank.en: He liked explaining things simply.

bank.fr: J'ai aimé le concert de vendredi.
bank.en: I enjoyed Friday's concert.

bank.fr: On devait présenter une pièce d'identité.
bank.en: We were required to show identification.

bank.fr: J'ai dû rentrer à pied.
bank.en: I had to walk home.

bank.fr: Les boutiques fermaient tôt en hiver.
bank.en: The shops used to close early in winter.

bank.fr: Cette semaine-là, les boutiques ont fermé trois jours.
bank.en: That week, the shops closed for three days.

bank.fr: Je croyais que l'entrée était gratuite.
bank.en: I thought admission was free.

bank.fr: J'ai compris le problème en voyant la facture.
bank.en: I understood the problem when I saw the bill.

bank.fr: Vous habitiez près de votre travail ?
bank.en: Did you use to live near your workplace?

bank.fr: Les voisins nous saluaient chaque matin.
bank.en: The neighbours used to greet us every morning.

bank.fr: Cet été-là, j'ai nagé tous les jours.
bank.en: That summer, I swam every day.

bank.fr: Le serveur apportait les plats sans parler.
bank.en: The waiter was bringing the dishes without speaking.

bank.fr: Nous mangions dehors malgré le vent.
bank.en: We were eating outside despite the wind.

bank.fr: Je commençais à comprendre l'accent.
bank.en: I was beginning to understand the accent.

bank.fr: Il fallait tourner après la poste.
bank.en: We had to turn after the post office.

bank.fr: La neige cachait les marques au sol.
bank.en: Snow was hiding the road markings.

bank.fr: Une agente nous a montré le passage.
bank.en: An officer showed us the passage.
bank.prompt: Add helpful action to a scene.

bank.fr: Je descendais l'escalier en tenant la rampe.
bank.en: I was going down the stairs holding the handrail.

bank.fr: Les passagers lisaient pendant que j'observais la ville.
bank.en: The passengers were reading while I watched the city.

bank.fr: Le quartier semblait désert après dix heures.
bank.en: The neighbourhood seemed deserted after ten.

bank.fr: Je me sentais plus à l'aise en petit groupe.
bank.en: I felt more comfortable in a small group.

bank.fr: Elle s'est levée dès l'annonce du départ.
bank.en: She stood up as soon as departure was announced.

bank.fr: Nous nous demandions où patienter.
bank.en: We were wondering where to wait.

bank.fr: Je n'entendais pas les annonces.
bank.en: I could not hear the announcements.

bank.fr: Le micro a cessé de fonctionner.
bank.en: The microphone stopped working.

bank.fr: Au début, je trouvais le cours difficile.
bank.en: At first, I found the course difficult.

bank.fr: Puis j'ai commencé à participer.
bank.en: Then I began to take part.

bank.fr: Nous espérions une réponse avant vendredi.
bank.en: We were hoping for a reply before Friday.
bank.cue: Espérions has no é in stem.

bank.fr: La réponse est arrivée trop tard.
bank.en: The reply arrived too late.

bank.fr: Il y avait une erreur sur mon billet.
bank.en: There was an error on my ticket.

bank.fr: L'agente a corrigé mon nom immédiatement.
bank.en: The officer corrected my name immediately.

bank.fr: Je tenais mon sac contre moi.
bank.en: I was holding my bag against me.

bank.fr: Le vent soufflait si fort qu'on avançait lentement.
bank.en: The wind was blowing so hard that we moved slowly.

bank.fr: Heureusement, un voisin nous a reconnus.
bank.en: Fortunately, a neighbour recognized us.

bank.fr: Nous étions épuisés, mais contents du résultat.
bank.en: We were exhausted but pleased with the result.

bank.fr: Depuis ce jour-là, je vérifie toujours l'adresse.
bank.en: Since that day, I always check the address.
bank.prompt: End a story with a lesson.

bank.fr: Je comptais les pièces quand le distributeur a rendu ma carte.
bank.en: I was counting the coins when the machine returned my card.
bank.prompt: Separate the ongoing action from the event.

bank.fr: À l'époque, notre chorale répétait dans un sous-sol qui résonnait beaucoup.
bank.en: At that time, our choir used to rehearse in a basement that echoed a lot.
bank.prompt: Describe a former group habit and its setting.
bank.cue: Two imparfaits describe habit and place.

activities.title: An interrupted wait
activities.prompt: What changed the speaker's plan? Listen for the event, not just the setting.
activities.script: Je patientais devant le centre sportif. Il pleuvait et plusieurs personnes attendaient sous l'abri. Je pensais que le cours allait commencer normalement. Puis une employée est sortie et nous a annoncé une fuite dans la piscine. J'ai donc décidé d'aller à la bibliothèque. Le froid ne me dérangeait pas vraiment.
options: An employee announced a pool leak.
activities.explanation: Rain and waiting set the scene. The announcement of the leak is the event that leads to the library plan; cold is explicitly not the main problem.

activities.title: A former routine and one event
activities.prompt: Which statement describes the exceptional event rather than the usual routine?
activities.script: Quand j'habitais au village, je prenais le même autobus chaque matin. Le chauffeur connaissait les habitués et nous disait bonjour. Un lundi, pourtant, il a changé d'itinéraire parce qu'un arbre bloquait la route. Nous sommes arrivés avec vingt minutes de retard. D'habitude, le trajet durait seulement quinze minutes.
options: The bus used a different route one Monday.
The driver greeted regular passengers daily.
The journey usually took fifteen minutes.
The speaker took the bus every morning.
activities.explanation: The route change is the particular completed event. The greeting, fifteen-minute duration and daily bus ride describe the former routine.

activities.title: The start of a workshop
activities.prompt: Why did the narrator initially stay silent?
activities.passage: Au début de l'atelier, je ne connaissais personne. Les autres participants échangeaient déjà des idées et parlaient assez vite. Je craignais de les interrompre, alors je prenais des notes. Puis l'animatrice m'a demandé mon avis. J'ai proposé une idée et le groupe l'a retenue. Après cela, j'ai participé plus facilement.
options: The narrator feared interrupting unfamiliar people.
The group rejected the first suggestion.
activities.explanation: The writer explicitly feared interruption and did not know anyone. The later accepted suggestion shows that silence was not necessarily a lack of ideas.

activities.title: A completed period
activities.prompt: Which interpretation best fits the account?
activities.passage: L'an dernier, j'ai travaillé trois mois dans une ferme. Je me levais tôt et je préparais le matériel avant l'arrivée de l'équipe. Un matin, une tempête a abîmé la serre. Nous avons passé deux jours à la réparer. Cette expérience m'a appris à demander de l'aide plutôt qu'à tout faire seul.
options: The writer still works at the farm.
The writer repaired the greenhouse every morning.
The storm lasted the entire three months.
The three months form a completed period containing routines and one incident.
activities.explanation: The account combines a bounded three-month experience, repeated morning routines and a specific storm/repair episode. A long period can use passé composé.

activities.title: A plan that changed
activities.prompt: Invent a past outing whose plan changed. Set the weather, place and people; introduce an unexpected event; explain your response and outcome. After one minute, answer the imagined follow-up: What did you usually do in that situation before? Use new details rather than memorizing the model.
activities.model: Samedi dernier, je voulais faire une promenade au bord du lac avec ma sœur. Il faisait beau, mais le vent soufflait assez fort. Nous préparions nos sacs quand un voisin nous a signalé la fermeture du sentier. Nous avons donc choisi un petit musée près de chez nous. La visite était intéressante et nous avons découvert une exposition de photos. Avant, je restais souvent chez moi quand une sortie était annulée. Cette fois, j'ai préféré chercher une autre activité.
rubric: Fulfillment: includes scene, change, response, outcome and former habit.
Coherence: listener can distinguish usual routine from that day's events.
Range: uses background descriptions and sequencing.
Control: imparfait and passé composé reflect intended viewpoint.
Intelligibility: natural phrasing and manageable pauses; no script reading.

activities.title: An anecdote for a course newsletter
activities.prompt: Write 100–140 words about a surprising first day in an invented class or job. Give background, two completed events and a reflection. Use an accessible newsletter tone. This is learning practice, not an official exam task.
activities.model: Mon premier jour à l'atelier de théâtre a commencé par une surprise. Je connaissais seulement l'adresse et je pensais observer le groupe sans parler. La salle était petite et les autres participants préparaient déjà une scène. Dès mon arrivée, l'animatrice m'a donné un rôle. J'ai accepté, mais j'avais peur d'oublier les mots. Pendant que les autres jouaient, je relisais mes phrases. Puis un participant m'a proposé de répéter avec lui. Nous avons travaillé dix minutes et j'ai réussi à terminer la scène. Avant, j'évitais toujours ce genre d'activité. Ce soir-là, j'ai compris que demander de l'aide pouvait rendre une situation difficile beaucoup plus agréable.
rubric: Fulfillment: first-day anecdote includes background, events and reflection.
Organization: scene and turning point are clear.
Range: varied verbs, time anchors and descriptive details.
Control: past tenses, participles and agreement support the story.
Register: readable newsletter voice within the suggested length.
